summary: All five TDD anchors implemented as integration tests against real Mongo, plus a null-message edge case. Assertions are behavioral and specific: exact-arg verify on advanceOnCallback, event-type + metadata entries, event-before-flip via the established sentinel-on-logEvent approach, re-entry no-op, bot-missing degrade, and a no-PII value check. The jsonNodeSlots() regression (callback_query removed from the telegram_update_other parameterized stream) is handled with an explanatory comment.

findings.finding: callbackQuery_callsAdvanceOnCallback_writesEvent, _eventBeforeStatusFlip_orderingInvariant, _reentryGuardDone_noOp, _botMissing_degradesNoAdvance, _eventCarriesNoPii all present; plus _nullMessage_advancesWithNullChatId for the inline-mode edge case.
jsonNodeSlots() no longer emits callback_query; nonMessageJsonNodeSlot_writesUpdateOther_noStubs stays green for the remaining opaque slots.
